scope.parent: logicalRegionName AND vdcName equal in SQL; logicalRegionName equal in ROUTER API
scope.why_router_region_fetch: full region parent catalog is required to reject nativeId collisions in other VDCs
scope.children: PORT, SUBNET and FLOATING_IPS APIs carry exact region; SQL repeats region; relation has no region field, scoped via validated port IDs
scope.no_az: additional scopes and obligations are rejected rather than dropped
scope.response_validation: The four CIs declaring logicalRegionName require that field and exact requested-region equality; wrong-region receipt rows reject before SQL. R_PORT_IN_SUBNET is a global relationship request with no declared region column: extra metadata is projected away, and relationship keys join the scoped PORT path. Full same-region ROUTER catalog across VDCs remains required.

relations: ROUTER.nativeId=PORT.devNativeId AND equal logicalRegionName; region/nativeId must uniquely identify ROUTER.id
FLOATING_IPS.routerId=ROUTER.id; nativeId is the wrong role
multiplicity: DISTINCT (vpc_id,subnetId) before aggregation; EIP COUNT DISTINCT id independently; LEFT aggregates onto parents; never join subnet rows directly to EIP rows

null_and_missing.missing_or_empty_identity: missing/NULL/empty/blank-only object id rejects in collect_pages; non-string identity rejects
null_and_missing.missing_eip_routerId: normalized NULL, counted in unknown_eip_parent_rows; not assigned to a VPC
null_and_missing.null_relation_subnetId: unknown_subnet_reference_rows; omitted from known reference count
null_and_missing.unresolved_nonempty_subnetId: included referenced, excluded resolved, included unresolved
null_and_missing.duplicate_identity: Any repeated id within one CI snapshot rejects, identical or conflicting, within or across pages. Distinct relation IDs may still share a business subnet key.
null_and_missing.unassigned_or_orphan_links: diagnostics retain unknown; business_complete is false
null_and_missing.blank_definition: Python str.strip() is used only to recognize blank-only strings. Nonblank opaque identities are never trimmed, merged or rewritten.
null_and_missing.nullable_foreign_keys: blank-only/empty/NULL nullable foreign keys project to NULL before SQL, with unknown relationship diagnostics; nonblank keys are preserved exactly

count_meanings.resolved_subnet_count: distinct referenced subnet identities that resolve in the requested region
count_meanings.referenced_subnet_count: distinct nonempty subnet references through the scoped VPC port path
count_meanings.unresolved_subnet_count: referenced minus resolved; not silently removed
count_meanings.known_eip_count: distinct EIP.id with a proven scoped parent link; not claimed to be a full total where any ownership/relationship is unknown

truth_and_failure.success_empty: zero-total successful page required; explicit empty schemas give no fake row; no-child parents get zero
truth_and_failure.failure_or_unknown: request failure, absent receipt, missing fields, changing totals, truncation/order/repeated-page errors reject; never convert to empty/zero
truth_and_failure.partial_graph: execute_local returns diagnostic business_complete=false; B must not use partial known counts as a complete answer to the original question
truth_and_failure.input_projection: B must execute only tables returned by preflight, including its NULL normalization and declared schemas; raw receipts are not interchangeable
truth_and_failure.completeness_scope: business_complete is only a known-local-graph flag after strict receipt preflight; partial graph means false. It never certifies a live atomic snapshot, B request binding, final runtime adoption or official business acceptance.
truth_and_failure.wrong_scope_or_duplicate: unsupported before SQL; cannot turn a rejected/incomplete input into a zero or complete result

pagination.checks: success, sequential complete declared pages, stable total/size, exact expected batch sizes, and unique nonblank object id within every CI; repeated identical or conflicting IDs reject; no object folding
pagination.limit: stable totals cannot prove a live atomic snapshot; official/live pagination still requires B/C acceptance

length_gate.status: provisional candidate encoding policy retained, official boundary unconfirmed
length_gate.candidate_guard_boundary: whole build() return serialized as compact ensure_ascii=False UTF-8 JSON
length_gate.static_boundary: a placeholder API+SQL skeleton is measured separately; it is not the final B request nor the original static rb_192
length_gate.expanded_execution_boundary: only api_call+sql after literal binding, measured separately
length_gate.final_B_envelope_boundary: not available or measured; B must validate the official final boundary
length_gate.error: LengthBlocked.details records measured full bytes, execution bytes, limit, boundary and no-truncation handling; oversized encoding does not declare the semantic entity invalid
length_gate.parameter_capacity: existing 1024-Unicode-character support cap retained; longer legal identifiers need another verified encoding, not truncation
length_gate.b_handling: B may separately validate a supported parameter binding/compact execution representation and final envelope; no new B path implemented here

entrypoints.build(params): closed API+SQL candidate; pure; no IO
entrypoints.collect_pages(pages): strict normalized page receipt validation; pure
entrypoints.preflight(params,receipts): validated projected rows plus unknown ownership diagnostics; pure
entrypoints.execute_local(params,receipts): synthetic/offline SQLite verifier with declared schema; not a new official executor

synthetic_positive_examples.purpose: multiple same-name VPC IDs, zero-child parent, repeated subnet via two ports, 2 EIPs, unresolved subnet

synthetic_negative_examples: tenantName or AZ added as an extra obligation

live pagination/snapshot, official business/reference meaning and runtime gate remain unvalidated
